title: Reply: Quarterly Report Draft
paragraphs: From: Anna Baker To: David Miller Subject: Reply: Quarterly Report Draft
Thank you for the draft report you sent yesterday. I will proofread the document today and revise the introduction section before I forward it to the finance department for review.

Please attach the spreadsheet showing the sales numbers so I can confirm the totals match the template we used last quarter. I still need to acknowledge a few comments from the sales team before I approve the final version.
Once the report is approved, I will reply to everyone on the list and let them know it is ready to print.

options: To request a new spreadsheet template

To ask for a printer repair
